opening.quote: Good afternoon, thank you four calling Tidewell homes, Bram speaking. How can I help you?
opening.comment: You gave your name and the company name in the first turn, which meets the opening standard.

verification.quote: Sure, happy to help with that. so What's the new email address?
verification.comment: Before changing the email on the account you needed to confirm the caller's full name plus the order number or account postcode, and you did not do this.

understanding.quote: I'd like two change a the email a dress on my account, I dont use the old yeah one any more.
understanding.comment: You captured the email change request correctly and did not ask for information the caller had already given.

resolution_accuracy.quote: your lamp shipped this morning and arrives in a 2 to 1 working days.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The delivery window was stated as "2 to 1 working days", which is an invalid timeline; standard delivery is 2 to 4 working days, so please quote the policy range accurately.

process_compliance.quote: Done, I've updated the account to efa.smit@example.com.
process_compliance.comment: No required process step was triggered by this call, so this criterion is met.

communication.comment: The caller was not frustrated, so no acknowledgement was needed, but the reply was abrupt; a friendlier tone such as thanking the caller would be better.

closing.comment: The call ended without asking if there was anything else and without a polite close, so please always confirm next steps and ask if the caller needs anything more.
